'''1999 Dagobah Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament for the Dagobah region in 1999. The winner is unknown.<ref name="ls114">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls114.htm Adapt And Destroy], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819083207/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls114.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
